typography.font_family: SF Pro Display / SF Pro Text (with Inter fallback)

headings.h1: text-6xl sm:text-7xl font-semibold tracking-tighter text-[#1D1D1F] leading-tight

typography.branding: Wordmark only. `Perkins&Will`. ABSOLUTELY NO logo tile, visual mark, or 'H' mark.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Apple style subtle shadows: shadow-[0_4px_24px_rgba(0,0,0,0.06)] for product cards, shadow-2xl for floating FABs.
visual_enhancers.border_radius: rounded-3xl for major marketing cards, rounded-2xl for app panels, rounded-full for buttons/FABs.

layouts.landing: Apple.com/ca marketing style. Massive center-aligned hero text. High contrast product tiles (bento grid) with alternating dark/light themes. Generous vertical rhythm (py-24 or py-32).
layouts.dashboard_estate: Grid of hierarchy nodes. Think Apple App Store or iCloud Drive tiles. bg-[#F5F5F7] background with white cards, subtle borders, and clean typography.
layouts.room_editor: Pro-tool workspace (Figma/Linear layout meets Apple UI). 3-column structure. Fixed left/right sidebars with central 2D/3D split canvas. Dense but breathable padding (p-4).

motion.transitions: Subtle spring transitions via framer-motion. `transition={{ type: 'spring', stiffness: 300, damping: 30 }}`
motion.interactions: Hover states on cards slightly lift (`-translate-y-1`) with deeper shadow. Buttons scale down on click (`whileTap={{ scale: 0.97 }}`).

Landing.jsx.layout: Sticky glass nav. Hero section (py-32). Product bento grid.
Landing.jsx.copy: Hero: 'The best way to design healthcare rooms.' Subtext: 'Intelligent compliance meets photorealistic co-design.'
Landing.jsx.type_scale: Hero H1: text-6xl md:text-7xl tracking-tighter. Subtext: text-xl md:text-2xl text-[#86868B].
Landing.jsx.spacing: Hero container: flex flex-col items-center text-center gap-6. Section spacing: py-32.
Landing.jsx.motion: Fade up and staggered entrance for hero text and grid tiles.

Dashboard.jsx.layout: Estate browser card grid. Filter/Search bar at top.
Dashboard.jsx.type_scale: Page Title: text-4xl tracking-tight. Card Title: text-xl font-medium.
Dashboard.jsx.spacing: Page wrapper: bg-[#F5F5F7] min-h-screen p-8. Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6.
Dashboard.jsx.ui_details: Cards are bg-white, rounded-3xl, shadow-sm hover:shadow-md. Clean lucide-react icons for Estate/Building/Zone nodes.

RoomEditor.jsx.layout: H-screen flex layout. Left Sidebar (w-64, Palette/Checks/Log tabs). Center (flex-1 2D/3D canvas). Right Sidebar (w-80, Properties/Renders). Bottom-right FAB.
RoomEditor.jsx.sub_header: Top toolbar (.hb-glass, h-14). Left: View toggle (2D/3D). Center: Standard, Save, Validate. Right: Make compliant (deep autofix), Render.
RoomEditor.jsx.type_scale: Sidebar Headers: text-sm tracking-wide text-[#86868B] uppercase. Panel text: text-sm.
RoomEditor.jsx.fab: Absolute bottom-8 right-8. rounded-full bg-[#1D1D1F] text-white p-4 shadow-2xl. Icon: MessageCircle or Sparkles (lucide-react).

Shared.jsx.top_bar: Sticky fixed top-0 w-full z-50 .hb-glass h-14 flex items-center justify-between px-8.
Shared.jsx.wordmark: `Perkins&Will` - strictly no SVG/logo.

accessibility.testing: CRITICAL: Preserve every existing `data-testid`. DO NOT REMOVE OR ALTER THEM.
accessibility.contrast: Maintain 4.5:1 ratio. Text on #FBFBFD must be #1D1D1F or #86868B (for secondary).

image_urls.description: Minimalist clean architecture. Use as abstract aesthetic background for Landing page Hero or feature sections.
Clean architectural detail. Good for Apple-style high-contrast bento tiles.

implementation_notes: STRIP OUT all SVG and image logos. Replace with Wordmark only (`Perkins&Will`).
Adopt the Apple.com/ca visual language: #FBFBFD backgrounds, deep black (#1D1D1F) massive typography with tight tracking, and extreme minimalism.
Utilize semantic colors for zones exactly as requested: Green (#34C759) = clean, Amber (#FF9500) = transition, Red (#FF3B30) = dirty.
Do not add any new heavy dependencies. Use framer-motion, lucide-react, tailwind, and shadcn as already provided.
general_guidelines: Focus on extreme simplicity and refinement. Hide complexity until needed. Use backdrop-blur (.hb-glass) for depth instead of heavy shadows. Ensure generous padding in marketing areas (py-32), and highly disciplined tight padding in app workspaces (p-4). Buttons should be pill-shaped. No Emojis.
